items.title: Remove legacy --web / --cli compatibility parsing from the dev launcher
items.context: Delete the hidden compatibility branch in packages/main/src/verifier/dev-cli.ts, keep the supported launcher flow unchanged, and make sure the file only reflects the documented surface.
items.userSees: Legacy --web / --cli flags no longer change how serve starts; the documented lattice serve flow stays the only supported path.

items.title: Add a regression check for the launcher contract
items.context: Cover the launcher with a small smoke or unit-style check so the removed flags do not silently return, and keep the documented serve entry points as the only supported ones.
items.userSees: The entrypoint check still ends with entrypoints verified, and it would fail if the old aliases reappear.
